briefing: - 今日清单未标在野利用或勒索软件关联，勿据此判断已活跃攻击。
- 批量公告趋势明显：LXD同一修复版本连发3条9.9分漏洞。
- 最需立即处置：9.9分命令注入CVE-2026-122193，优先排查暴露面。
- LXD越权与输入校验缺失均9.9分，升级至c5184be310b1修复版。
- 另有多个9.8分认证绕过/SQL注入，建议同步紧急修补。

items.summary_zh: 仅影响OpenSSL FIPS模式下的Python 3.14.10，哈希算法强制策略回归，可绕过FIPS算法校验
items.difficulty: 低(远程·利用条件苛刻·免认证)

items.action_zh: 升级至含修复的Python版本，或暂不在FIPS模式使用

items.impact_scope: 特定FIPS合规环境，面窄
items.description: There was a regression in how FIPS algorithms were enforced for the hashlib module. Only users that are using OpenSSL in FIPS mode are affected. Only Python 3.14.10 is affected, all other Python versions are unaffected.

items.title: AWS REX SSM 文档命令注入提权
items.title_zh: AWS REX SSM 文档命令注入提权
items.summary_zh: 获授权调用Rex-RO/RW SSM文档的远程用户可注入命令，以root在受管实例执行并绕过Cedar策略
items.action_zh: 升级到 2026-07-28 之后版本并收紧SSM文档授权
items.repro_note: 认证用户调用Rex-RO/RW SSM文档注入命令参数
items.impact_scope: 云端受管实例，需认证授权
items.description: OS command injection in the example SSM document provisioning script in Trusted Remote Execution (REX) before 2026-07-28 might allow an authenticated remote user who is permitted to invoke the Rex-RO or Rex-RW SSM document to execute arbitrary commands as root on the managed instance, bypassing Cedar policy enforcement. To remediate this issue, users should delete any Rex-RO and Rex-RW SSM documents created from the example script, in each account and Region where it was run.

items.description: As snapshots can be moved from one server to another, a malicious instance+snapshot can be crafted locally, moved to a restricted project and the snapshot restored for arbitrary command execution. In practice, this allows a malicious actor to execute arbitrary commands on the host with root privileges.

items.title: LXD 恶意镜像符号链接逃逸

items.summary_zh: 导入含顶层符号链接（rootfs指向/）的镜像，可读写宿主机任意文件并以root执行命令

items.description: Reported from https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-2q3f-q5pq-g8wv ### Summary A specially crafted image can be used to read or create/write arbitrary files on the host; possibly leading to arbitrary command execution. ``` metadata.yaml rootfs/ rootfs -> / ``` In practice, this allows a malicious actor to access the host's filesystem with root privileges.

items.repro_note: 导入含构造符号链接的镜像后写入宿主机任意目录
items.impact_scope: 容器/虚拟机宿主机，可提权root

In practice, this allows a malicious actor to access an arbitrary directory and edit arbitrary files in it.

items.repro_note: exec接口record-output参数配合镜像exec-output符号链接

items.description: Reported from https://github.com/lxc/incus/security/advisories/GHSA-48q5-w887-33wv ### Summary The `record-output` parameter of the `/instances/$name/exec` endpoint stores the output of the command in the `exec-output` directory of the instance. ### Details When an image is unpacked, top-level symlinks are extracted as is; allowing for `exec-output` to be placed on disk.

items.title: SQL仪表盘变量替换致未认证SQL注入
items.title_zh: SQL仪表盘变量替换致未认证SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证用户向公开/嵌入图表的URL过滤参数注入，可在存储SQL查询中执行任意语句
items.action_zh: 升级到 5.2.1 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 向公开/嵌入图表URL过滤参数注入，需存在公开图表
items.impact_scope: 面向公网的数据看板，数据泄露
items.description: Prior to 5.2.1, SQL dashboard-variable substitution used attacker-controlled JavaScript replacement strings unsafely across SQL connectors and separately failed to escape backslashes for MySQL and MariaDB quoted contexts. An unauthenticated user sends crafted URL filter values to a public or embedded chart backed by a stored SQL query.

items.title: 2FAuth 认证绕过致管理员接管
items.title_zh: 2FAuth 认证绕过致管理员接管
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可在全新实例创建管理员，或劫持已知账户邮箱，窃取2FA密钥与后台权限
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本，限制公网暴露并监控管理员创建
items.repro_note: 未认证访问注册/邮箱验证接口创建管理员或改绑邮箱
items.impact_scope: 自建2FA管理Web应用，敏感凭证
items.description: 2FAuth is a web app to manage Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) accounts and generate their security codes. An unauthenticated remote client can therefore create an administrator on a fresh instance or impersonate and redirect email for a known account, exposing 2FA secrets and administrative functions.

items.title: 2FAuth 未认证认证绕过
items.title_zh: 2FAuth 未认证认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可绕过认证，访问2FA密钥与管理员功能（细节尚未完全披露）
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本，限制公网暴露
items.repro_note: 未认证访问认证接口绕过校验，细节待披露
items.impact_scope: 自建2FA管理Web应用，敏感凭证
items.description: 2FAuth is a web app to manage Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) accounts and generate their security codes. Prior to 8.0.0, when AUTHENTICATION_GUARD=reverse-proxy-guard is enabled, ReverseProxyGuard::user() reads the default REMOTE_USER identity header, or a custom identity header selected by the AUTH_PROXY_HEADER_FOR_USER configuration setting, without confirming that the request originated from a configured trusted proxy.

items.title: 聊天服务 默认JWT密钥致认证绕过
items.title_zh: 聊天服务 默认JWT密钥致认证绕过
items.summary_zh: 攻击者用默认CB_SECRET伪造HS256令牌指定目标用户ID，绕过API与Socket层认证
items.action_zh: 替换默认CB_SECRET为强随机值并升级版本
items.repro_note: 以默认CB_SECRET签发HS256令牌指定目标用户ID
items.impact_scope: 聊天服务API与Socket接口
items.description: The vulnerable surface is session JWT fallback in server/modules/verifyToken.js, verifyUser.js, getUserFromToken.js, and socketManager.js across the API and socket layer. A stock source or repository Docker Compose deployment retains a known, weak, or default CB_SECRET and an attacker submits a forged HS256 token decoding to a target user id.

items.title: 无人机控制服务 未授权会话接管
items.title_zh: 无人机控制服务 未授权会话接管
items.summary_zh: 可访问3334端口的未认证攻击者可直接取得已认证会话，下发特权指令操控无人机与航线
items.action_zh: 限制3334端口访问，启用TLS与认证后升级版本
items.repro_note: 直连0.0.0.0:3334未认证取得会话后调用特权指令
items.impact_scope: 无人机地面控制服务，暴露内网
items.description: UgCS server before 6.2 contains an authentication bypass in the HCI protocol login handler (LoginHandler) exposed on TCP port 3334. Because the service listens on all interfaces (0.0.0.0) without TLS by default, an unauthenticated remote attacker with network access to port 3334 can obtain an authenticated session without knowing any credential and then issue privileged commands, including commanding connected drones and uploading flight routes.

items.title: JetBrains Hub 验证流程权限提升
items.title_zh: JetBrains Hub 验证流程权限提升
items.summary_zh: 攻击者利用邮箱验证流程中篡改认证信息，可将账户提升至更高权限并接管他人身份
items.action_zh: 升级到 2026.2.52556 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 在邮箱验证流程中篡改认证绑定信息提权
items.impact_scope: 内网统一认证/账号中心
items.description: In JetBrains Hub before 2026.2.52556 privilege escalation was possible by changing email authentication details during the verification flow

items.impact_scope: 本地开发终端，需用户交互
items.description: In JetBrains CLion before 2026.2, 2026.1.4 code execution was possible in Safe Mode via Meson project settings

items.repro_note: 打开含恶意JSON compilation database的工程
items.impact_scope: 本地开发终端，需用户交互
items.description: In JetBrains CLion before 2026.2 code execution was possible in Safe Mode via JSON compilation database

items.title: JupyterLab 重定向致令牌窃取RCE
items.title_zh: JupyterLab 重定向致令牌窃取RCE
items.summary_zh: 诱导用户打开含恶意MathJax链接的不可信笔记本，窃取本地URL与令牌后经REST API执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级到 JupyterLab 4.4.8 或更高版本
items.repro_note: 不可信笔记本中MathJax链接经getServerInfo窃取令牌
items.impact_scope: 数据分析环境，用户交互触发
items.description: In a local managed session using JupyterLab before 4.4.8, an attacker can place a crafted MathJax link in an untrusted notebook. The site can call getServerInfo to obtain the local server URL and authentication token, then use the Jupyter REST API to create and trust a notebook that executes arbitrary code as the victim.

items.title: Welcome 渲染器XSS经IPC致RCE
items.title_zh: Welcome 渲染器XSS经IPC致RCE
items.summary_zh: 诱导用户提交构造URL，在Welcome渲染器执行JS并滥用特权IPC桥以用户权限执行代码
items.difficulty: 低(远程·免认证·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级到厂商修复版本，谨慎打开外部链接
items.repro_note: 构造URL在Welcome渲染器触发XSS后调用IPC桥
items.impact_scope: 桌面客户端，需用户交互
items.description: An attacker who convinces a user to submit a crafted URL can execute JavaScript in the Welcome renderer and abuse its privileged IPC bridge to execute arbitrary code with the user’s privileges. The Welcome view also unsafely renders RSS news-feed titles; exploitation through this separate input path requires control over content delivered through the application’s Jupyter Blog feed or its cached feed data, rather than submission of a remote-server URL.

items.title: Chartbrew队列面板缺失认证
items.title_zh: Chartbrew队列面板缺失认证
items.summary_zh: 远程未授权攻击者可直连启用了Redis/BullMQ的Chartbrew的/apps/queues管理面板，操控队列任务并泄露数据
items.action_zh: 升级至修复版本；临时在反向代理封禁/apps/queues并关闭BullMQ面板
items.repro_note: 直接访问 /apps/queues；前置：Redis与BullMQ已启用、反代未拦截该路由
items.impact_scope: 内网BI报表平台，管理面暴露
items.description: The vulnerable surface is the Bull Board/BullMQ administration dashboard at /apps/queues. A remote unauthenticated attacker reaches /apps/queues on a Chartbrew instance where Redis and BullMQ are enabled and a reverse proxy does not independently block the route.

items.title: Red Hat CI工作流引入不可信代码
items.title_zh: Red Hat CI工作流引入不可信代码
items.summary_zh: 能提交PR的攻击者利用pull_request_target工作流执行不可信代码，窃取SNYK_TOKEN及仓库写令牌
items.affected: Red Hat(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 轮换SNYK_TOKEN及仓库写令牌，收紧workflow权限与PR触发条件
items.repro_note: 向目标仓库提交特制PR触发pull_request_target工作流，观察密钥外带
items.impact_scope: 代码托管CI流水线，供应链入口
items.description: A remote attacker could exploit a vulnerability in the pull_request_target workflow by submitting a specially crafted pull request. This workflow processes untrusted code from the pull request author while operating with the base repository's sensitive secrets, such as the SNYK_TOKEN, and its default write token.

items.title: 本地部署数据库 xp_cmdshell 提权
items.title_zh: 本地部署数据库 xp_cmdshell 提权
items.summary_zh: 拥有sysadmin权限者可借助自动启用的xp_cmdshell，在数据库服务器上执行操作系统命令
items.action_zh: 禁用xp_cmdshell并升级到厂商修复版本
items.repro_note: 需sysadmin权限，调用xp_cmdshell执行系统命令
items.impact_scope: 数据库服务器，需高权限前置
items.description: Jumis (formerly Tildes Jumis) creates and uses a Microsoft SQL Server login named ##Tilde_JumisAdmin## whose password is derived deterministically from a single non-secret input - the SQL Server name (@@servername). The on-premise server installation also programmatically enables xp_cmdshell during routine operation, so sysadmin access escalates to operating-system command execution on the database server.

items.title: Chartbrew API连接SSRF探内网
items.title_zh: Chartbrew API连接SSRF探内网
items.summary_zh: 可创建API连接的用户可篡改allowPrivateHost字段，令服务端请求内网HTTP服务，造成信息泄露或未授权操作
items.action_zh: 升级至5.2.2之后的修复版本，服务端强制忽略该字段的用户输入
items.repro_note: 认证后在创建/更新API连接时注入allowPrivateHost=true并指向内网地址
items.impact_scope: 内网BI平台，可作内网探测跳板
items.description: In versions 4.8.5 through 5.2.2, API connection creation and update operations accept the internal allowPrivateHost field from user input. Successful exploitation allows requests to internal HTTP services reachable from the Chartbrew server, potentially disclosing information or triggering unauthorized actions depending on the target service.

items.title: Datalore只读协作者可执行代码
items.title_zh: Datalore只读协作者可执行代码
items.summary_zh: 仅有查看权限的协作成员可在notebook计算单元中执行代码，导致服务端任意代码执行
items.difficulty: 中(远程·需低权限·需用户交互)
items.action_zh: 升级至 Datalore 2026.4 及以上版本
items.repro_note: 以只读协作者身份打开notebook，在计算单元写入并运行代码
items.impact_scope: 数据分析平台，多用户协作内网
items.description: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.4 code execution was possible in a notebook's computation by view-only collaborators

commits.title: H1: Add a synthetic capture and tests
